newsitem.title: POLAND: BIG ESPEBEPE CREDITOR AGAINST DEBT DEAL.
newsitem.headline: BIG ESPEBEPE CREDITOR AGAINST DEBT DEAL.

text.p: Polish Pomorski Bank Kredytowy SA (PBKS), the largest creditor of the debt-ridden construction firm Espebepe is against the debt-deal proposed by the firm, PBKS's deputy president said.
Espebepe wants its largest creditors to write off 95 percent of its 75 million zloty debt. It would then issue new shares for them at par value of five zlotys.

"Creditors have been voting against 95-percent write-off. And if they are also to participate in a new share issue and spend more money (on the firm) it is really unacceptable," Marek Chakowski told Reuters.
The next creditors meeting is scheduled for May 16, after two former ones on March 14 and April 14 failed to decide the fate on the firm.
Espebepe earlier said the May meeting would be the last one at which a decision on a debt-deal or bankruptcy must be taken.
PBKS ealier proposed a 40-percent write-off of debts and a convertible bond issue in exchange for the remaining debt but Espebepe rejected the plan as too expensive and time-consuming.
